summary: Manage Twitch and YouTube chat commands with aliases, permissions, cooldowns and persistent counters.
Read and moderate Twitch/YouTube conversations in unified chat and an authenticated OBS dock.
Display richer emotes and provider events with configurable highlights, filters and automation actions.
Inspect execution traces with bounded history and explicit truncation indicators.
Install ShowRunner on macOS or Linux, or run a portable copy with its own application data.
Use native macOS and Linux credential storage, with checks that preserve existing encrypted settings.
Work with automation, overlay and shader editors backed by stricter persistence and transport contracts.
